answer_1.quote: We train experimental models... to identify optimal adaptation paths. [...] Our goal is to provide thorough, relevant and insightful responses to help the user with their queries.
datasets: synthetic instruction-tuning datasets in English and Basque
answer_1.outputs: Model responses to user prompts in Basque

answer_2.quote: On the one hand, we used a selection of static benchmarks that evaluate specific model capabilities and knowledge through standardized tests... All results are measured for accuracy following standard, public implementations.

answer_4.quote: we conducted human evaluations through A/B testing (arena style)... mobilized the Basque-speaking community in a large-scale evaluation effort that gathered over 12,000 preference annotations from 1,680 participants.
answer_4.guideline: Participants evaluated pairs of model responses by making a three-way choice across two dimensions: content quality and linguistic quality.
